summary: Full backend + frontend testing after CORS_ORIGINS change. All 8 pytest backend tests pass (auth login/me with httpOnly cookie, invalid credentials rejection, public news list, news create/read/update/delete auth-gated CRUD, contact submit + auth-gated contact-requests list). Frontend: admin login → /admin/news works, New Article dialog creates article and shows success toast + article in list, Delete flow works (window.confirm auto-accepted, article removed, Deleted toast shown), Contact form submit shows success toast 'Thank you for reaching out. Our team will contact you shortly.'. Credentialed CORS still works end-to-end after the CORS_ORIGINS change.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console) — non-blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to admin New Article dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: startup seed_admin re-hashes password if it doesn't verify — good and idempotent.
Cookie set with SameSite=None; Secure=True — appropriate for cross-site credentialed auth.
CORS_ORIGINS is read from env; allow_credentials=True with explicit origin list — correct.
Delete via window.confirm is OK for admin-only tool; could migrate to shadcn AlertDialog for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Created a test contact request (name=TEST_User / uitest2@example.com) and a temporary News article which was deleted after test — News list is back to empty clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be reused as regression suite. All flows green after CORS change.
